setup.body: One ledger per family. Everyone you invite sees and adds to the same register.

home.emptyBody: Create your own function to log gifts you receive, or another family's function to log what you gave.

more.comingNextBody: Sync across phones, duplicate merging, invite-card scanning, PDF and Excel export, Hindi, and app lock.

signIn.f3: Full give-and-take history with any family
